text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of Narita Brian's debut is finally here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I check the list, but there's a normal number of racers for a debut race.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Hmph. How I'm feeling now doesn't really matter.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I won't know anything until I run. But this just might be the place that actually fulfills me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …All right, it's time. My Twinkle Series debut starts here.
